property_summary: Filling an order that is long and call mints tokens for maker and filler and increases c.address balance by zero when ERC20 baseAsset is non-weth and premium transfers occur via ERC20 safeTransferFrom (i.e., contract balance doesn't change for non-weth premium transfers).
For any non-weth long call order that successfully fills (no revert), the maker is owner of uint256(orderHash) and the filler (this contract) is owner of uint256(hashOppositeOrder(order)).

property_summary: For any long call order where fillOrder does not revert, the maker becomes owner of uint256(hashOrder(order)) and the filler (this contract) becomes owner of uint256(hashOppositeOrder(order)).

If fillOrder succeeds for a short non-call order (isLong==false, isCall==false), then the filler (msg.sender) becomes owner of the short position token (uint256(hashOppositeOrder(order))) and the contract's ERC20 balance for the baseAsset increases by the strike amount held by the contract (observable via no direct getter so we instead observe that withdraw/transfer to maker would not revert — instead we assert minted ownership).
If fillOrder returns (does not revert) for a long non-call order, then the filler (msg.sender) is minted the opposite (short) position token (ownerOf(hashOppositeOrder(order)) == address(this)).
Filling an order mints a token to the maker whose ownerOf(id) equals the maker and also mints the opposite-position token to the filler (msg.sender) when fillOrder succeeds (i.e., does not revert).
